customMethods.script:
def deleteProductionOrderMetaData(workOrderMetaDataId, userId):
		'''
			Deletes a production order meta data entry (kanoaOPS)
			Args:
				workorderMetaDataId: int
				userId: int
			Returns:
				# of records modified: int
				msg: str - None if success
			
			Updated:
				jfc - 7/25/24 1:36pm Created
		'''
		
		log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_order')
		log.warn("deleteProductionOrderMetaData() called for %s by %s"%(workOrderMetaDataId, userId))
		dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('core')		
		
		import java.lang
		try:
			return system.db.runPrepUpdate("DELETE FROM mes.[workOrderMetaData] WHERE workOrderMetaDataId = ?", [workOrderMetaDataId], dbName, getKey=0), None
		except java.lang.Exception, e:
			log.warn("deleteProductionOrderMetaData() returned %s"%e.cause)
			return False, e.cause

	workOrderMetaDataId = self.view.custom.metaDataInfo.workOrderMetaDataId
	if (workOrderMetaDataId or None) is None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'invalid metaDataId.'})
		return
		
#	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.order.deleteProductionOrderMetaData(item['workOrderId'], self.view.custom.security.userId)
	retVal, msg = deleteProductionOrderMetaData(workOrderMetaDataId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'Could not delete meta data. %s'%msg})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Work Order meta data has been deleted.'})

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.metaDataInfo.metaData")
	
	return
